decks.notes: The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to gain and maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while advancing its own. The inclusion of cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon also allows the deck to further disrupt opponents playing non-basic lands, providing additional ways to gain control and secure victory.

The main focus of this Legacy Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt opponents' mana bases by deploying cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. Additionally, the deck aims to apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers, while also utilizing burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption to finish off opponents quickly. The inclusion of fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide allows for explosive starts and enables the deck to establish board presence early on.

This Dimir Tempo deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will while deploying efficient threats like Brazen Borrower and Nethergoyf. The deck focuses on tempo plays, using cards like Daze to capitalize on early game advantage and keep the opponent on the back foot. By mixing disruption with aggressive creatures, the deck aims to control the game's pace and win through incremental advantage. The key concept of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy to come out ahead in the end.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize. It then uses Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a quick victory. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces and disruption spells like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to control the opponent's board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to dig for combo pieces while also providing card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By quickly deploying threats like Skyclave Apparition and Stoneforge Mystic, while also disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares, this deck aims to maintain board control and pressure the opponent into making suboptimal plays. With the addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck gains additional value and versatility, allowing for more consistency in its aggressive game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to rapidly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach. The deck aims to apply pressure early on with aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Barrowgoyf while utilizing removal spells like Fatal Push to clear the way. The inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Stalactite Stalker offer additional ways to interact with the opponent's resources. With a focus on efficiency and disruption, this Mono Black Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and seize victory quickly.

The deck aims to quickly and efficiently combo off by casting a sequence of spells that leads to milling the entire library and winning the game with Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Simian Spirit Guide to power out its combo pieces. Cards like Cabal Therapy and Unmask help disrupt opponents' strategies while also enabling the combo. The main goal is to execute the combo as quickly as possible, before the opponent has a chance to interact or disrupt the game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly dumping all cards from the library into the graveyard to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It utilizes a combination of fast mana, discard spells, and creatures that mill the library to achieve this goal. The key strategy is to use cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the library, while also protecting the combo with Pact of Negation. The deck aims to win the game in one explosive turn, often catching opponents off guard with its speed and efficiency.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while deploying efficient threats to control the pace of the game. It combines creature removal, hand disruption, and counterspells to keep the opponent off balance. The goal is to apply pressure early with aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower and Nethergoyf, while using cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your board state. The deck also utilizes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Brainstorm to maintain card advantage and stay ahead in the resource game.

The deck is focused on quickly casting a large number of spells to win the game in a single turn. It includes cards that allow for fast mana generation and card draw to help assemble the combo pieces. The win condition typically involves using cards like Balustrade Spy or Undercity Informer to mill the entire deck, using Dread Return or Reanimate to bring back Thassa's Oracle for the win. The deck also includes disruption cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and Pact of Negation as a backup countermeasure.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back to the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces. It utilizes a combination of reanimation and control elements to overwhelm your opponent and quickly close out the game with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The mana base includes utility lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Combo - Show and Tell deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb, in order to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath using Show and Tell. The deck also features a lot of card manipulation and protection with cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Flusterstorm. Once Omniscience is in play, the deck can cast spells for free and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on using the combo of reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. Cards like Reanimate, Entomb, and Animate Dead are key to quickly bringing back creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized to support the combo pieces, with some utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this deck is to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Daze to disrupt your opponent's hand and plays, combined with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, this deck aims to maintain tempo and keep the opponent on the back foot. The deck also includes key cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push to handle any threats that may arise, ensuring a versatile and disruptive play style.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to rapidly deploy large threats and disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void. By using cards such as Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to accelerate its board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful dragons and burn spells. The deck also includes high-impact spells like Sundering Eruption and Fury to clear the way for its creatures to attack unchecked. With a focus on aggressive strategies and disruptive elements, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can establish control.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to ramp up mana quickly and drop powerful Eldrazi creatures and colorless spells. It aims to control the board by using cards like All Is Dust, Thought-Knot Seer, and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes key cards like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Ugin, the Ineffable for additional control and card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining a strong mana base provided by the Cloudpost and Tron lands.
